title: Interpretable by Design: Boosting Neural Network Performance with Rule-Augmented Features

contributions.purpose: 自动抽取高质量可解释规则作为特征
contributions.mechanism: 基于信息增益从训练数据挑选decision-stump规则(top-K)
contributions.evaluation: 选出3条规则,覆盖74.2%样本、平均精度75.3%
contributions.source_quote: A systematic pipeline for extracting high-quality decision stump rules from training data using information gain-based selection

contributions.purpose: 用规则增强神经网络兼顾性能与可解释
contributions.mechanism: 两种混合架构HybridConcat(拼接规则输出)/HybridResidual(线性规则+残差MLP)
contributions.source_quote: Two novel hybrid neural architectures (HybridConcat and HybridResidual) that integrate rules as interpretable features

contributions.purpose: 证明规则增强不牺牲反而提升性能
contributions.mechanism: 与MLPOnly基线在合成表格数据上对比
contributions.source_quote: our HybridConcat model achieves 86.32% accuracy (+3.85% improvement) with 3 interpretable rules providing 74.2% sample coverage.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work advances this field by proposing architectures that allow neural networks to learn arbitrary non-linear interactions between extracted rules and raw features, maximizing the synergy between symbolic and neural components.

notes: trade-off声明:号称打破accuracy-interpretability权衡(+3.20%绝对提升同时仅3规则)。数据红旗:全部实验仅在合成表格数据上(5条内嵌ground-truth规则的自造数据),无任何真实数据集。数字口径混淆:摘要/结论反复写"+3.85% improvement",实际Table1为83.12→86.32即绝对+3.20%、相对+3.85%,以相对值当卖点。checklist Q5"Open access"答[Yes]称"完整代码已作补充材料提供",但Reproducibility Statement又说"source code will be made publicly available upon publication"——自相矛盾(自称已附vs发表后才公开)。AI参与度四项全[D](AI主导)。reject。
